about_the_game:
The story of the main character "Ruina" and the support robot "Nekoro", and the Genesis Log that spells out the past.

The story unfolds from two perspectives.

What happened in the past and the present...

To deal with the crisis facing humanity, Ruina and Nekoro continue their exploration.

-Action

A high-speed action shooting game that moves at high speed to target floors, walls, and ceilings.

Use two types of weapons, α and β weapons, appropriately.

Resource management and timing of attacks are required.

Combinations of strengthening items can greatly change your combat style!

Think about your strategy in preparation for powerful boss enemies.

-Item collection

You can obtain various strengthening items during exploration.

They will be lost when you return from the exploration, but they all have powerful performance.

Use the items you obtain at the end of the exploration to unlock new equipment!

Find your own strongest build!

There are... more than 300 types of items...?

- Take on boss battles and high-difficulty content

Strong enemies await in each area.

You can change the difficulty level in the settings, so it's very challenging!

Challenge the score rankings in the boss rush!

-Major improvements and adjustments from the mobile version

The Steam version includes the difficulty level and features we originally wanted, and we've added systems and adjusted the balance in various ways, including the difficulty setting function, so that even those who have played the mobile version extensively can enjoy it in a new way.

The game progresses at a good pace, and you can now obtain many tokens needed for unlocking and strengthening, allowing you to collect them smoothly throughout the game.

In the latter half of the high difficulty setting, extremely powerful attack patterns have been added to the bosses, so you may have to retry many times.

The difficulty level can be changed at any time from the title screen, so feel free to give it a try.

-Distribution guidelines

- You are free to post videos and live streams of this game, including monetization, as long as you follow basic morals.

- There is no need to contact us in advance.

- We would appreciate it if you could include the store page (the URL of this page).
